itens.titulo: Prediction: Alphabet Could Be One of the Market’s Biggest Winners Over the Next 5 Years
itens.descricao: Prediction: Alphabet Could Be One of the Market’s Biggest Winners Over the Next 5 Years Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - GOOG delivered record Q2 results with revenue up 24% and Google Cloud surging 82%, yet shares sit at just $341, well below their 52-week high.
- A $514 billion cloud backlog with over half expected to be recognized within 24 months gives Alphabet unusually visible future revenue growth.
- Reaching $500 by 2027 requires a 47% gain and hinges on Cloud compounding, TPU sales ramping, and Gemini 4 solidifying Google's AI leadership.
Parent company Alphabet grew revenue 24.23% to $119.80 billion in Q2, and Google Cloud grew 82% to $24.77 billion.
Even so, shares are up only 8.99% year to date at $341.35.
That leaves one question for this article: can Alphabet reach $500 in 2027?
What's Holding Alphabet Back Right Now Q2 capex came in at $44.92 billion, up 100.14% YoY, and that pushed free cash flow to -$5.86 billion.
To pay for the AI buildout, Alphabet raised roughly $70 billion in equity and debt and paused buybacks.
